params.body:
The judge reads every signal an insight's patterns brought in against its claim: supports, partly or unrelated. An opened insight listed the unrelated ones under itself, folded as "the 33 signals judged unrelated to the claim", counted them in its evidence line ("; 33 about something else") and drew them as a grey stretch in its groove. That puts signals under an insight only to say they do not belong there. It is not a corner case: on the twelve best backed insights this week, 389 of 743 signals are judged unrelated, between 20 and 42 per insight.

## What changes

- **The opened insight** (card and page) lists what bears it out, what does in part and, folded, what is not checked yet. The unrelated fold is gone, and "All N signals on its page" and the source mix in "How it was made" count only those signals.
- **The evidence line** on the opened insight, the Overview cards and the review queue drops "; N about something else": "3 signals outright and 1 in part, from 3 sources; 1 not checked yet."
- **The groove** draws outright, in part and the track for not checked yet; the grey stretch and `.groove-off` are gone.
- **"How it was made"** keeps the count in one sentence: "Its patterns also brought in 33 signals that, read against its claim, are about something else. They are left out."

The agent door's starting point already leaves these signals out (`starting-point.mjs`); the dashboard now does the same. Nothing changes in the pipeline: the verdicts stay, on the current claim, so a rewritten claim reads them again.

## Checks

- `npx playwright test`: 85 pass. A new test opens an insight with two unrelated signals and checks that neither appears, that nothing names them on the page, and that "How it was made" counts them.
- `npx eslint` on the touched files: clean.
params.title: Leave the signals judged unrelated out of an opened insight
